_comment: Created P1.8 2026-07-02 — referenced by SKILL.md ('go find intel on [topic]') since v1 but never shipped. Tier 1 = official/primary (search first, trust most). Tier 2 = high-signal secondary. Tier 3 = community/unverified (label findings 'unverified'). {topic} in search_pattern is replaced with the user's query. Workspaces may append their own entries; keep tiers honest.

1.name: Anthropic docs + release notes
1.search_instructions: WebSearch, then WebFetch the top doc pages. Official docs settle feature claims — check here before recommending any feature.

1.name: Official vendor docs (tool named in the topic)
1.search_instructions: WebSearch; prefer the vendor's own domain in results.

2.name: Engineering blogs + changelogs
2.search_instructions: WebSearch; recent posts (90 days) only — older gets the outdated flag.

2.name: YouTube (talks, demos)
2.search_instructions: WebFetch gives metadata only; transcripts need the user to paste (see SKILL.md Step 1).

3.name: X/Twitter
3.search_instructions: WebSearch ONLY — WebFetch returns empty on X (JavaScript-rendered). Label all findings 'unverified' until confirmed in a Tier 1 source.

3.name: Reddit / HN
3.search_instructions: Community signal — good for gotchas and real-world friction, never for feature claims.
